description: Fetch the full lead field metadata list (id, displayName, name, dataType, length) and searchable_fields for the configured Marketo instance. ALWAYS writes the field descriptors to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never inline -- this is a business-connector record-read verb under the 07-29 spill floor even though its content is schema metadata, not customer PII. searchable_fields is the authoritative instance-specific set accepted by get_leads.filter_type, returned directly (not written to the file).
embedding_description: Retrieve the Marketo Lead Database field schema and metadata catalog to a workspace TSV: searchable field names accepted as get_leads filter_type, REST names, display names, data types, and each field's read-only status. Also returns searchable_fields directly. Use before a read-modify-write preflight to learn which fields this instance accepts.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo lead field schema exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, row_count (field count), and searchable_fields. Each row's `rest` column carries that field's REST `name` and `readOnly` flag as a JSON-text cell, and on SOME rows an additional `soap` sub-object with its own name/readOnly. ⚠ Read `rest.readOnly` — it is the key that governs REST writes. A row can carry NO `soap` sub-object at all (measured 2026-07-30 on a live instance: the fields whose read-only status actually blocks a read-modify-write had a `rest` block and no `soap` block), so a preflight that falls back to `soap` sees nothing precisely where it counts. A row can also carry no `rest` block at all, in which case that field is invisible to the REST API. Read-only membership is a per-instance property to be read here at execution time; it is not a fixed cross-instance list. searchable_fields is `null`, not an empty list, on an instance whose describe response omits the top-level searchableFields key entirely (Dax Part 32.1, 2026-07-31) — absence is not evidence the instance has no searchable fields, so the call still succeeds with the field metadata intact rather than failing the whole read.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export: the written path, the row_count (field count), and searchable_fields. Name the path for downstream use but do not inline its contents.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch the Marketo lead field schema and write it to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing output_tsv_path or its parent directory does not exist. marketo.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). marketo.auth_failed: the OAuth credentials were rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks a required Access API permission (e.g. Read-Only Person). marketo.rate_limited: the instance's API rate limit was exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the marketo_plugin config and reload it. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied: run check_setup to see the exact missing Role permission.
